---
description: Mandatory API documentation quality for C/C++ changes.
applyTo: "**/*.{c,cc,cpp,cxx,h,hh,hpp,hxx,ipp,tpp}"
---

- Every new or changed public API must be documented.
- Doxygen comments must include purpose, params, return behavior, and edge cases.
- Keep docs synchronized in the same change set.
- Missing docs are review blockers.
